# How Lob protects you – and your customers

SECURITY + COMPLIANCE

Whether you're automating transactional direct mail or running data-driven campaigns, Lob helps shield your business from costly compliance risks while keeping your customer data secure.

[Book a demo](https://www.lob.com/security#bottom-sales-form) [Get started for free](https://dashboard.lob.com/register)

![Lob Security Hero Image](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e1e5c62fa3d4447af417098/681e7c32da7b010c13e77e24_security_hero_image.png)

## Security at every step of the mail journey

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e1e5c62fa3d4447af417098/681bd3ee1d5c5196cc061e7b_security-icon.avif)

Platform controls

We provide robust account controls, plus access to audit and API request logs for enhanced security oversight and monitoring

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e1e5c62fa3d4447af417098/681bd3eeddf11baf6798cd4c_compliance-icon.avif)

Data protection

We keep your customer data safe with encryption in transit and at rest, automatic redaction, and built-in data retention policies to reduce exposure

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e1e5c62fa3d4447af417098/681bd3ee7fc197f3f8345121_Group%201597880605.avif)

Trusted printer partners

We regularly audit our nationwide network of printers to meet our strict security, privacy, and operational standards

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e1e5c62fa3d4447af417098/681cf870f8704cad967d70af_soc2-icon.avif)

Compliance support

We align with leading frameworks like SOC 2 and HIPAA, and are assessed regularly through independent reviews

### Lob defends the data your business runs on

- **Encryption** Experience peace of mind with industry-leading encryption: TLS 1.2+ for data in transit and AES-256 for data at rest.
- **Access management** Seamlessly manage user access and permissions with Single Sign-On (SAML 2.0) and role-based access controls.\*
- **Proactive monitoring** Always know what’s going on with your account – and spot risks – with programmatic access to audit and API request logs.
- **Secure hosting** Lob is powered by the secure, reliable, and scalable infrastructure of Amazon Web Services (AWS).

\*Available with Enterprise subscription only

![Image of Lob Dashboard](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e1e5c62fa3d4447af417098/6820f158bb7ec9a01d6f107b_dashboard.avif)

![Image of Code Editor](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e1e5c62fa3d4447af417098/6820f15812ff566e2d3ac16d_code_image.avif)

### Minimize risk with infrastructure built for resilience

- **Secure software development workflows** We employ automated testing, static security analysis, dependency vulnerability scanning, and mandatory code reviews to minimize risks.
- **Infrastructure as code** We maintain our infrastructure configurations through code, ensuring every deployment is consistent, secure, and fully auditable.
- **Rapid threat response** We catch vulnerabilities early with real-time monitoring, automated scanning, and regular penetration testing from independent experts.

Print delivery network

### 66% of operations executives cite delivery timing to avoid compliance risks as a major challenge. Lob’s Print Delivery Network is built to beat the clock – and the risk.

Lob’s Print Delivery Network combines nationwide scale with rigorous quality and security standards – so your mail moves fast, stays secure, and arrives exactly as intended.

[See how it works](https://www.lob.com/print-delivery-network)

![Lob Print Delivery Network](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e1e5c62fa3d4447af417098/66fd8ed9498a9d4ba20fe462_Group%201597880554.svg)

![HIPPA Compliance Image](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e1e5c62fa3d4447af417098/6820f158c58fb2187fc8052e_e1fbb3b14625e12e4e2cddff335a7fac_hippa_compliant.avif)

### Industry-leading direct mail compliance

Meet regulatory requirements and avoid costly violations with security practices that support HIPAA, GDPR, and CCPA/CPRA. We also complete annual SOC 2 Type 2 audits across all five Trust Services Criteria, which may help you meet your legal and contractual obligations.

SECURE MAIL FOR HEALTHCARE

### Need support for HIPAA compliance? We’ve got your back.

If your organization handles protected health information (PHI), Lob combines industry-standard processes with vetted facilities to give you confidence in the secure handling of sensitive information.
